description: Section-level 'regenerate just this part' for any AIToolPage tool that opts in via sectionable={true}. Parses the AI output into sections (## headings, **Section N:** bold lines, or numbered prefixes) and renders one button per section that re-prompts the AI with the rest-of-document as context to rewrite only that part. Halves credit usage for refinement passes and is especially valuable for the 12-section BehaviourPlan and the long IEP/RiskAssessment outputs.
steps: Create client/src/lib/section-parser.ts with parseSections(text) and replaceSectionBody(text, index, newBody) helpers that recognise ATX headings, bold-only lines, and short numbered prefixes.
Add a sectionable?: boolean prop to AIToolPage.
On the result view, when sectionable && parsedSections.length > 1, render a small 'Regenerate just one section' panel listing each section as a chip-button.
On click, call AI with system='rewrite ONLY this section, do not echo heading' and other sections as read-only context, then splice the new body back into the result via replaceSectionBody.
Re-run validators after a section regenerate so quality checks stay current.
Opt SmartTargets and BehaviourPlan into sectionable={true}.
acceptance_criteria: Tools opting in show one chip per detected section.
Clicking a chip rewrites only that section while leaving the rest untouched.
Tools that don't opt in see no UI change.
verification: Manual: generate a Behaviour Plan, regenerate only the Response Strategies section, verify other sections are byte-identical.
findings: Section parser is intentionally lenient — it recognises three heading styles to handle AI output drift between runs. Verified via --noResolve syntax checks.
